$comment: Every label in the repository, applied by scripts/apply-github-settings.mjs. Edit here, not in GitHub's UI. Families: type (GitHub's defaults), status:, area:, priority:.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something isn't working

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New feature or request

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs, site or planning documents

labels.name: question
labels.description: A question about using Agent Rewake

labels.name: accessibility
labels.description: Barrier affecting people with disabilities

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security hardening (report vulnerabilities privately: SECURITY.md)

labels.name: breaking
labels.description: Changes behaviour, configuration or stored data incompatibly

labels.name: status: needs triage
labels.description: Not yet looked at by a maintainer

labels.name: status: needs reproduction
labels.description: Waiting for steps, versions or logs; closed after 14 days without them

labels.name: status: needs info
labels.description: Waiting for an answer from the reporter

labels.name: status: confirmed
labels.description: Reproduced or agreed; ready to work on

labels.name: status: proposal
labels.description: Needs a written proposal before code (docs/proposals)

labels.name: status: blocked upstream
labels.description: Waits on Zed, ACP, an agent adapter or Anthropic

labels.name: area: scheduling
labels.description: Scheduled and repeating messages, delivery, the store

labels.name: area: usage limits
labels.description: Limit detection, resume after a limit, automatic resume

labels.name: area: agent tools
labels.description: The MCP tools the agent uses to schedule (src/mcp.ts)

labels.name: area: thread UI
labels.description: The Rewake menu, forms and status lines in a thread

labels.name: area: schedules page
labels.description: The schedules page and CLI listing (src/ui)

labels.name: area: install
labels.description: install, uninstall, doctor and launching agents

labels.name: area: agents
labels.description: Support for a specific agent (Claude, Codex, Gemini…)

labels.name: area: ci
labels.description: Workflows, checks and repository settings

labels.name: priority: high
labels.description: Breaks a main flow or loses data; fix next

labels.name: priority: medium
labels.description: Real problem with a workaround

labels.name: priority: low
labels.description: Minor; welcome if someone picks it up

labels.name: good first issue
labels.description: Small, well-described, good for a first contribution

labels.name: help wanted
labels.description: A maintainer would welcome a pull request

labels.name: duplicate
labels.description: This issue or pull request already exists

labels.name: invalid
labels.description: Not a problem with Agent Rewake

labels.name: wontfix
labels.description: Won't be worked on; the issue says why

labels.name: dependencies
labels.description: Updates a dependency (Dependabot)

labels.name: javascript
labels.description: Updates npm dependencies (Dependabot)

labels.name: github_actions
labels.description: Updates GitHub Actions (Dependabot)

labels.name: no-changelog
labels.description: A change people can't see: the changelog check doesn't apply

labels.name: release
labels.description: A release pull request (prepare-release)
